Armed violence escalated on 17 May 2026, when an explosive device reportedly dropped from an unmanned aerial vehicle exploded near St Paul’s Catholic Church in Mbamogo Village, Agisiga District, injuring four community members after Sunday mass. One of them, Mr Luter Nabelau, later succumbed to his injuries. Two Papuan women, Mrs Otovina Hogajau, and Mrs Aliana Pogau were seriously injured during an alleged Indonesian military drone strike in Danggoa Village, Agisiga District, Intan Jaya Regency, on 18 June 2026. A 19-year-old civlian, Mr Makelon Majau, was again injured during alleged Indonesian military drone strikes targeting Balamai Village in Hitadipa District, Intan Jaya Regency, on 22 June 2026.
